paper_title: Helioscope Bounds on Hidden Sector Photons
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter chi, dimensionless (plot shows Log10 chi; values emitted as linear chi)
notes: Redondo (arXiv:0801.1527): combined solar-lifetime and CAST helioscope bounds on hidden-photon kinetic mixing chi vs m_gamma'. Not a dark-matter search (solar emission), so no DM density assumed. Paper provides no numerical table; data points are a reconstruction of the combined exclusion envelope (Fig. 6) using explicit formulas in the text: CAST bound chi*m^2 < ~7e-12 eV^2 for m<0.01 eV, chi*m < ~1e-9 eV for 0.01<m<1 eV; luminosity bound W = 9.4e43 chi^2 (m/eV)^4 W < L_sun below 1 eV; resonant lifetime bound reaching stated chi ~ 1e-14 near m ~ 295 eV; bulk-emission plateau chi ~ 1e-11 for 0.3-10 keV, bound vanishing near 40 keV. The best limits claimed for 3 meV < m < 40 keV. Values approximate (order-of-magnitude reliable, factor ~2-3 uncertainty); the 'Gas'-filled CAST curve is a projection and was excluded. Confidence level not explicitly stated (CAST result used 95% CL). | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('envelope of the combined constraints') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 41)) | Vision: Figure 6 shows upper limits on kinetic mixing chi vs hidden photon mass. Traced the lower envelope of the combined constraints: Helioscope (CAST) line (slope -2 below ~0.01 eV, kink at m~0.01 eV where oscillations become incoherent, slope -1 up to ~1 eV) dominates for m < ~1.5 eV; the black T-Lifetime solar energy-loss bound dominates from ~1.5 eV to ~15 keV with minimum chi~1e-14 at m~200 eV (resonance feature causes sharp jump at ~250-300 eV); above ~16 keV the boundary rises steeply. Paper notes bounds become indeterminate above 40 keV. The 'Gas' line (prospective) and L-Lifetime were not included in the envelope since they are prospective/weaker. Points read from log-log plot pixel positions; ~0.1-0.2 decade uncertainty in chi. | Calibration: Vision calibration: ×1e+2 (factor=1.00e+02, reason=spot-check verify/stage2, raw_ratio=37.50)
